contract: A PROVEN_IRRELEVANT rule removes only the one item blocker it names, and only when every operand of its predicate is authoritative for this request. The H&S Battle/Calc damage contract is the single-hit damage range and its percentage of the defender's max HP for the current observed state; the shipped H&S engine emits no KO/survival text (calculateHnsDamage returns koChanceText ""). Missing operands return UNKNOWN, which never clears. Effect suppression (Klutz, Embargo, Magic Room) only removes a hold effect, so every irrelevance proof below also holds under suppression.

operands.ordinary_move: The selected move is ORDINARY_PROVEN_EQUIVALENT in HnsMoveMechanicsRegistry (single-hit EFFECT_HIT, fixed power, no state-dependent flag) and has no HnsMoveItemInteractionRegistry interaction.
operands.effective_move_type: HnsMoveAuthority.effectiveType: request.moveOverride.type (pinned move + Fairy toggle) of an ordinary move, accepted only when the live attacker gimmick is observed GIMMICK_NONE, the live attacker ability is known and is not one GetDynamicMoveType reads (Normalize 96, Refrigerate 174, Pixilate 182, Aerilate 184, Liquid Voice 204, Galvanize 206), Electrify is observed false, and the observed gFieldStatuses word has no unknown bit and no Ion Deluge rewriting a Normal move. No other field bit changes an ordinary move's type, so an unrelated terrain/room/Gravity bit does not remove this authority.
operands.effective_category: HnsMoveAuthority.category: the ordinary move's pinned category under an observed PER_MOVE_SPLIT (with GIMMICK_NONE; no field bit changes it), or the category of the authoritative effective type under TYPE_BASED; unknown otherwise.
operands.wonder_room_inactive: The live gFieldStatuses word observed, fully decoded, with STATUS_FIELD_WONDER_ROOM clear.
operands.no_terrain: The live gFieldStatuses word observed, fully decoded, with every STATUS_FIELD_TERRAIN_ANY bit clear.
operands.clear_weather: The live gBattleWeather word observed exactly 0.

context_rules.predicate: A physical Choice Band or special Choice Specs hit while the live active gimmick is Dynamax.
context_rules.rationale: The pinned CalcAttackStat branches explicitly omit the respective Choice multiplier during Dynamax; the independent gimmick capability gate still handles Dynamax move semantics.

context_rules.predicate: The item is held by the defender.
context_rules.rationale: Every damage-path read of these hold effects is the attacker's (ctx->holdEffectAtk / holdEffectAtk / gSpecialStatuses[battlerAtk]); the defender's copy is only read when the defender itself attacks, or by Fling/Knock Off/Incinerate, which are gated separately or act after damage.

context_rules.rationale: Choice Band, Muscle Band and Thick Club apply only when IsBattleMovePhysical(move); Thick Club also requires base species Cubone, Marowak, or Alolan Marowak.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Physical.
context_rules.rationale: Choice Specs, Wise Glasses and Deep Sea Tooth apply only when IsBattleMoveSpecial(move).

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type differs from the item's pinned secondaryId type.
context_rules.rationale: Type boosters and Plates multiply only when moveType == GetItemSecondaryId(item); a Gem only arms gemBoost when GetBattleMoveType(move) == GetItemSecondaryId(heldItem).

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type is outside the item's two boosted types (Water/Dragon, Steel/Dragon, Ghost/Dragon, Psychic/Dragon).
context_rules.rationale: Each branch requires the move type to be one of its two types; Soul Dew uses the B_SOUL_DEW_BOOST >= GEN_7 type branch (GEN_LATEST), so its Sp. Def branch is inactive.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose effective category is Special.
context_rules.rationale: Wise Glasses multiplies base power by UQ4.12 4505 (1.0 + 10% floored) per pinned H&S src/battle_util.c:6818 and is modelled in the QuickJS calculator.

context_rules.predicate: Attacker holds a critical-stage-only item and the selected move is an authoritative ordinary single hit with a fixed isCrit flag.
context_rules.rationale: Scope Lens/Razor Claw, Lucky Punch and Leek change only crit selection probability, which the H&S range does not output.

context_rules.rationale: GetBattlerHoldEffectInternal suppresses every ordinary hold-effect consumer under these live conditions; raw item identity remains available to item-specific gates.

context_rules.rationale: Missing suppression operands cannot prove that an item modifier is active or absent, so the request remains fail-closed.

context_rules.predicate: The live current or generated base species matches a pinned item predicate.
context_rules.rationale: The H&S engine uses source-generated current/base species identity and applies the exact item stage.

context_rules.predicate: The item is held by the attacker.
context_rules.rationale: Every damage-path read of these hold effects is the defender's (ctx->holdEffectDef in CalcDefenseStat, GetDefenderItemsModifier, type effectiveness and GetAdjustedDamage). Assault Vest's other read only restricts its holder's status-move selection.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move whose authoritative effective type differs from the berry's holdEffectParam type.

context_rules.rationale: Focus Sash endures only when IsBattlerAtMaxHp(defender), i.e. hp == maxHP.

context_rules.rationale: The source usesDefStat result, including Wonder Room, proves the item branch inactive.

context_rules.rationale: Unknown live predicates do not become a neutral berry modifier; the Kotlin authority is shared with the serialized QuickJS decision.

context_rules.rationale: The pinned berry predicate requires the Normal exception or a Q4.12 effectiveness modifier of at least 2.0.

context_rules.rationale: IsUnnerveBlocked returns a neutral modifier before the type/effectiveness berry branch; the source-backed ability identity and liveness are shared with request policy.

context_rules.rationale: The selected hit receives the exact source UQ4.12 half modifier in GetDefenderItemsModifier.

context_rules.predicate: The exact current resist berry resolves to HOLD_EFFECT_NONE under observed Embargo, Magic Room, or active Klutz.

context_rules.predicate: The shared berry authority is bound to an exact current item that is not the audited resist berry.
context_rules.rationale: A different current numeric item cannot activate this item's berry branch.

context_rules.rationale: A consumed berry is not resurrected from historical item state; current held identity is the consumption authority.

context_rules.predicate: The hold effect cannot change the current hit because it activates after the damage event, at end of turn, or outside hit resolution; source-generated onSwitchIn activations also require settled switch-in events. This applies to every move shape; unsupported move mechanics remain a separate refusal.
context_rules.rationale: Listed items write HP, stat stages, volatiles, or held-item state after the selected damage event or outside hit resolution. Generated gHoldEffectsInfo activation metadata gates any on-switch-in effect until the event pipeline settles; later-hit effects cannot authorize the current result and the move gate remains independent.

context_rules.predicate: Any move shape; Blunder Policy writes Speed after a miss and Room Service writes Speed after Trick Room activates, after current hit order is established. Room Service also has a generated on-switch-in activation and is gated until switch-in settlement.
context_rules.rationale: After any Room Service switch-in activation has settled, later speed writes cannot change an already-established hit order. Current-action Analytic authority owns that order operand; no ordinary-hit or non-Analytic restriction applies, and unsupported move mechanics remain independently refused.

context_rules.predicate: The holder’s effective ability is neither Protosynthesis nor Quark Drive.
context_rules.rationale: The pinned Booster Energy activation dispatch only calls the item effect for Protosynthesis or Quark Drive; another ability has no Booster Energy damage consequence.

context_rules.predicate: Switch-in settlement is observed and the holder’s Protosynthesis/Quark Drive activation flag and boosted-stat payload are valid.
context_rules.rationale: Booster Energy itself has no damage multiplier. The live ability and its source-selected boosted stat are consumed by the modeled stat modifier; a consumed item is not inferred from item absence.

context_rules.predicate: Exact generated single-hit drain family with independently authorized execution and observed effective item state.
context_rules.rationale: Big Root applies floor(healing*1300/1000) after floor(measuredDamage*absorbPercentage/100); zero healing becomes one. Liquid Ooze then converts recovery to passive attacker damage. Neither alters the selected defender hit. Other mechanics remain independently gated.

context_rules.predicate: Source-generated frozen Whirlpool ID 250, supported fixed selected hit; no future-turn output.
context_rules.rationale: Wrap is established after damage. Binding Band alters only later end-turn residual; globally damage-relevant classification remains.

always_blocking.predicate: Booster Energy is active on a Protosynthesis or Quark Drive battler.
always_blocking.rationale: The damage-time modifier reads separate boosterEnergyActivated and paradoxBoostedStat fields. The runtime reader does not observe those operands, so stat stages alone cannot prove the item effect is represented.

post_hit_or_residual.fallback: A non-ordinary or unknown move never clears.

context_rules.rationale: Air Balloon and Iron Ball feed the exact IsBattlerGrounded result used for the four selected-hit terrain modifiers. Gravity takes precedence; Magic Room and unsupported active grounding volatiles remain unknown.

context_rules.predicate: Ordinary move and live gBattleWeather observed 0.
context_rules.rationale: Every Utility Umbrella read is conditional on sun or rain; GetWeatherDamageModifier returns 1.0 before reading it when there is no weather.

context_rules.predicate: The observed exact weather word contains neither B_WEATHER_SUN nor B_WEATHER_RAIN.
context_rules.rationale: Utility Umbrella suppresses only Sun/Rain applicability. Sand, hail/snow, fog and strong winds do not activate the selected-hit Umbrella branch.

always_blocking.predicate: Live weather is sun or rain.
always_blocking.rationale: The holder ignores the weather modifier; not modelled.

weather_shield.fallback: Unobserved or non-clear weather never clears.

context_rules.predicate: Authoritative ordinary single-hit move, observed Singles topology, both persistent volatile windows observed with Gastro Acid clear, neither effective ability is active Neutralizing Gas, no defender-side Mold Breaker can affect the hit, and the selected move lacks ignoresTargetAbility.
context_rules.rationale: Ability Shield changes whether Gastro Acid, Neutralizing Gas, or an ability-breaking attack suppresses the holder ability; with those sources absent, it cannot affect this hit.

context_rules.predicate: A Red Orb or Blue Orb is held before switch-in/form-change settlement is authoritatively complete.
context_rules.rationale: The pinned battle form table applies Primal Reversion during form-change settlement. Until the event state settles, observed species and resulting ability/weather are not a complete damage authority.

context_rules.predicate: Primal form-change settlement is complete but the holder’s live current species is not observed.
context_rules.rationale: The item does not have a separate damage multiplier; the transitioned species and its resulting ability/weather must be observed directly rather than reconstructed from raw item identity.

context_rules.predicate: Primal form-change settlement is complete and the holder’s live current species is observed.
context_rules.rationale: The form table changes live species. The damage calculation consumes observed species/stats/ability/weather and does not add a second Orb modifier; this does not mean that the Orb has no battle effect.

context_rules.predicate: An ordinary selected hit has authoritative selected-gimmick and active-gimmick values, both GIMMICK_NONE, while holding a Mega Stone or Z-Crystal.
context_rules.rationale: Mega Stones and Z-Crystals have no direct ordinary-hit multiplier with no selected or active gimmick. Any selected or active unsupported gimmick remains independently refused, and item-dependent move semantics remain separately gated.

always_blocking.predicate: A current suppression source can affect the holder or the defender ability during the hit.
always_blocking.rationale: Ability Shield prevents the source ability-suppression path from removing the holder ability.

form_or_ability_changer.fallback: Missing live topology, ability identities, or persistent volatile observations remains UNKNOWN.
